latHint: Think puffing up your hair with a comb.
pivHint: RIBS protect your chest - but if you RIB someone playfully, it means to do what to them?
winText: All in good fun. RIBS was the pivot - drop the S and to RIB someone is simply to TEASE them.
lossText: TEASE - to poke fun at someone. RIBS was the pivot: drop the S and to RIB a friend means the same as to TEASE them.
